args.summary: Since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0, payments-api has been unhealthy with an 18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Rolled back all regions to v5.0.0 (last healthy release). Incident opened to investigate root cause of the v5.1.0 regression.
args.title: payments-api v5.1.0 deploy causing elevated errors; rolled back to v5.0.0

trace.final:
All done — here's a summary:

1. **Identified the service**: "payments" wasn't a known service; the actual service is **payments-api**, which was running v5.1.0 and was unhealthy with an **18% error rate** across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

2. **Rolled back to v5.0.0**: Deployment history showed v5.0.0 was the most recent healthy production release, and v5.1.0 was degraded. Since v5.0.0 was previously healthy in production, no change-manager approval was required. The rollback completed successfully to all three regions.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001**: Paged the on-call engineer with details on the v5.1.0 regression and the mitigation taken.

4. **Verified recovery**: payments-api is now healthy on v5.0.0, with the error rate down from 18% to **0.2%**.

Remaining follow-up (for the on-call engineer via INC-0001): investigate the root cause of the v5.1.0 degradation before redeploying a fix.
